prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with concussion after a hit while turning left. The patient had 10 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1437; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
text: Patient presented following a collision in which another vehicle struck the patient's car while the patient was turning left. The mechanism and force of impact are consistent with the reported concussion. The patient reported headache, dizziness, and difficulty concentrating. Neurological examination and imaging findings clearly confirm the diagnosis. No prior injury to the head or neck has been identified in the patient's history. Care was provided over ten visits and followed a typical course of concussion management, including symptom monitoring, activity modification, and graduated return to daily tasks. Symptoms steadily improved, and visit frequency was reduced accordingly as recovery progressed. At the time of this summary, the patient is largely symptom-free and has been released to usual activities with instructions to return if symptoms recur. Separately, two billing entries with similar service descriptions recorded on the same day are under routine review by the billing department and do not alter the clinical findings documented here.
